items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report states that AI handles data analysis and pattern recognition from client conversations so that relationship managers can focus on life planning and deeper advisory work requiring human judgment.

items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report states that AI predicts triggers and opportunities, enabling relationship managers to engage clients proactively at moments of relevance rather than only during periodic reviews.
items.quote: AI predicts triggers and opportunities, enabling RMs to engage clients at moments of real relevance, rather than in response to periodic reviews or client-initiated interactions.

items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report describes a large wealth firm implementing a reimagined AI-powered desktop that delivers a humanlike, empathetic, personalized, and contextual client experience.
items.quote: Capgemini helped implement a reimagined, AI-powered desktop that delivers a humanlike, empathetic, personalized, and contextual experience through three integrated capabilities.

items.text: Schwab's CEO states that AI can create personalized and deeper relationships with clients the firm cannot currently serve at scale one-to-one.
items.quote: AI can help us create personalized and deeper relationships with the clients we can't currently serve at scale with one-to-one relationships.

items.text: Schwab's CEO states it is rolling out Portfolio Insights, an AI-enabled experience delivering tailored insights to clients about their investment portfolios, performance, holdings news and proprietary research.
items.quote: we will begin the rollout of portfolio insights, an AI-enabled experience that will deliver tailored insights to our clients about their investment portfolios, how they are performing relative to indices, the news about their holdings and the relevant proprietary research

items.text: Schwab's CEO describes Charley, an AI-powered assistant that gives retail clients conversational access to Schwab's tools and insights and can take action on a client's behalf for administrative tasks such as changing an address.
items.quote: Charley combines best of third-party LLMs with Schwab's trusted data and security... can take action on a client's behalf for some administrative tasks like changing an address or naming a trusted contact.

items.text: A WealthTender survey finds many clients want their advisor to be local but express a preference for meetings to be conducted online, and that people are comfortable when AI enhances human capabilities rather than replacing human judgment.
items.quote: many people still said they want their advisor to be local, but expressed a preference for meetings to be conducted online... People are most comfortable when AI enhances human capabilities rather than replacing human judgment.

items.text: Deloitte research states that for clients, agentic AI should make faster responses, more tailored insights, and more proactive outreach the minimum standards of the advice experience.
items.quote: Faster responses, more tailored insights, and more proactive outreach should become minimum standards.

items.text: Bank of America's investor day deck lists deploying personalization capabilities based on client preferences as a key accelerant.
items.quote: Deploying personalization capabilities based on client preferences

items.text: Bank of America's CFO states that AI-enabled tools help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale.
items.quote: new AI-enabled tools that help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale

items.text: Raymond James's CEO states the firm will invest in people, platforms and capabilities that help financial professionals deliver more holistic and personalized advice, while noting client relationships will be helped by AI and technology.
items.quote: we'll continue to invest in the people, platforms and capabilities that help our financial professionals deliver more holistic and personalized advice... it will be helped by AI and technology.

items.text: Edward Jones's 10-K states its strategic ambition is to help investors achieve financial fulfillment through personalized, comprehensive planning and trusted advice, investing in technology to scale financial planning.
items.quote: The Partnership's strategic ambition is to help tens of millions of investors achieve financial fulfillment through personalized, comprehensive planning and trusted advice... Continue investing in technology to scale our ability to provide financial planning to our clients

items.text: Capgemini states its Business-Ready Data for AI foundation enables accurate recommendations that balance personalization with suitability and delivers trusted AI insights to provide the right advice at the right time.
items.quote: delivering accurate recommendations that balance personalization with suitability... delivering advisors with the trusted AI insights needed to provide the right advice at the right time
